sources.inspection: Read existing-building description and inspected aerial, site/roof plan and all four elevations. Existing roof 124 ft 2 in, parapet 127 ft 1 in, penthouses about 152 ft 6 in to 153 ft. Property line 273 by 344 ft is not forced onto the smaller mapped shell. U-shaped upper mass, narrow Market lightwell, low court roofs and southwest pool annex are visible. Proposed antenna drawings are excluded from modeled equipment.
